The synthetic dataset has eight numeric features, a 30% positive rate and 5% label noise.
The first 80% of rows are used for training and the rest for testing (data seed 7).
The model is logistic regression trained by mini-batch SGD for 15 epochs (batch size 32, a constant learning rate of 0.05, no weight decay and no class weighting).
Predictions use a decision threshold of 0.5.
